PER.definition_en: Proper names referring to individual persons, including public figures and private users. Usernames are PER when they denote a person account. Excludes common role nouns and pronouns.

LOC.definition_en: Geographical places and named locations such as countries, cities, regions and landmarks. Use LOC for place mentions, not for organizations via metonymy.

ORG.definition_en: Named organizations including companies, clubs, governments, media outlets and online platforms. Usernames can be ORG when denoting an institutional account.
positive_examples: Centers for Disease Control and Prevention

final_task_goal: This dataset provides a social-media–native NER resource for recognizing persons, locations and organizations in tweets. * Document pool and source: English Twitter posts sampled across times and regions, including news outlets, public figures and general users. * Purpose of NER: Deliver high-quality annotations for PER, LOC and ORG under tweet-specific tokenization, with adjudicated labels for ambiguous cases. * Entity types: Three categories—Person (PER), Location (LOC), Organization (ORG)—with context-sensitive handling of usernames, hashtags and metonymy. * Downstream applications: Support benchmarking of NER in noisy short-text settings, power event detection and trend analysis, and enable entity-centric retrieval and monitoring pipelines.
